issues.issue: Did the RAD independently assess the country evidence on family members of LGBTQ activists?
issues.applicant_position: RAD relied on the RPD's findings and ignored documentary evidence of violence against family members of LGBTQ persons.
issues.respondent_position: RAD did its own analysis (paras 21-23); applicant failed to link the general evidence to her circumstances.
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that the RAD failed to independently assess the evidence.

issues.issue: Did the RAD underestimate the serious possibility of persecution from the applicant's FDC activity?
issues.applicant_position: Low-level FDC activity and a past assault mean a serious possibility of persecution; RAD wrongly required past persecution.
issues.respondent_position: Applicant asks the Court to reweigh evidence; RAD weighed the full record and found no link to persecution.
issues.result_quote: I do not agree that the RAD elevated the threshold that the PA was required to meet as submitted by the PA.
